effects: Kuwait: Iranian strike kills worker at Chinese firm · Jordan intercepts missiles again
iran: Egypt confirms Damietta LNG carriers hit (evening prior) · Iran denies
tldr: Egypt confirmed drones had struck the LNG carriers Energos Winter and GasLog Salem at Damietta port overnight, with fires extinguished and Iran denying involvement. Kuwait reported an Iranian morning strike killed a worker at a Chinese company's building; Jordan intercepted Iranian missiles for a second straight day while the IRGC's claim of destroying three F-35s in Jordan remained unverified.
